title: SmartRecruiters jobs input
description: Which boards to read, what to search inside them, and whether to fetch job descriptions.

companies.title: Companies or careers URLs
companies.description: SmartRecruiters board identifiers (SGS) or careers URLs (https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/SGS). The identifier is the segment right after the domain in the careers URL. A board typed twice is read once.

query.title: Search inside the board
query.description: Sent to the SmartRecruiters search (q=): the server narrows the board before anything is downloaded, which is much cheaper than filtering 4 000 postings locally. Empty reads every open posting.

country.title: Country code
country.description: Lowercase ISO-2 code such as us, de or pe. Applied by the server. Anything that is not two letters is ignored, and the summary says so instead of pretending the filter worked.

releasedAfter.title: Released after
releasedAfter.description: ISO date such as 2026-11-01. Applied by the server, so it is the cheapest way to follow a board daily. An unparsable date is ignored and the summary says so.

keywords.title: Title contains any of
keywords.description: Keywords for the job title, matched in code because the API has no title filter. Separate alternatives with commas; a space inside stays one phrase, so 'game designer' does not match 'game artist'. A posting that does not match is counted in filteredOut and is not charged.

excludeKeywords.title: Title excludes
excludeKeywords.description: Words or phrases that drop a posting by its title. Separate alternatives with commas; a space inside stays one phrase. Dropped postings are counted by reason and cost nothing.

location.title: Location contains
location.description: A city, region or country word matched as a whole word, so us does not match Australia. Empty keeps every location.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep postings the board marks as remote, or whose location says remote or anywhere.

employmentType.title: Employment type contains
employmentType.description: Substring of the label the board publishes, for example full-time or permanent. Filtered in code: the API ignores its own typeOfEmployment parameter, measured 07.11.2026.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level contains
experienceLevel.description: Substring of the level the board publishes, for example senior or entry. Filtered in code: the API ignores its own experienceLevel parameter.

department.title: Department contains
department.description: Substring of the department the board publishes, for example Laboratory. Filtered in code: the API answers HTTP 400 for its own department parameter.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max postings per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Hard stop per board. 0 means no limit and the run then walks up to 8 000 postings. Postings the run did not reach are counted in jobsNotProcessed, postings the board has but the run did not read in jobsNotRead, so the sums stay honest.

includeDetails.title: Fetch job descriptions
includeDetails.description: One extra request per delivered posting (about 0.2 s each) that brings jobDescription, qualifications, additionalInformation and companyDescription. Postings whose description fails are still delivered, with detailError set.

maxDetails.title: Max descriptions
maxDetails.description: Upper bound on description requests in one run, so a 4 000 posting board cannot run for an hour. 0 means no bound. Postings past the bound are delivered without a description and counted in detailsSkipped.

requestPaceSecs.title: Pause between requests (seconds)
requestPaceSecs.description: Polite delay between two list requests. Descriptions use at most 0.1 s. The API answers a page in about 0.3 s, so 0.3 here is roughly one page per second.
